title: Social Media Murders
description: A skateboarder is murdered in Liverpool; missing a murder weapon and a motive, a Snapchat message where the killers brag about their plan helps the police crack the case.

title: Social Media Murders
description: Bianca Devins' death at the hands of friend Brandon Clark; exploring the virtual world of misogyny he lived in and learning why the victim's family had to battle social media platforms to remove viral images of her murder.

title: Hunting the Catfish Crime Gang
description: Having posted his life on social media, James Blake's identity is stolen and used in scams; as he sets out to try and get his face and name back, James discovers a modern-day crime wave where ruthless organized gangs are using the latest technology.

title: How I Caught the Killer
description: In 2017, terror grips the Seminole Heights neighborhood of Tampa after shootings claim the lives of four innocent victims, all of whom are murdered by serial killer Howell Emanuel Donaldson III.

title: How I Caught the Killer
description: After Gordon Wardell makes an emotional appeal to find his wife's killers, the police soon realize they must look closer to home as they dig deeper into suspicions.

title: How I Caught the Killer
description: After his body was found in his Rothienorman cottage, handyman Brian McKandie's death in 2016 was initially deemed accidental, but a pathologist soon discovered severe injuries that pointed to murder.

title: Tales of the Grim Sleeper
description: Filmmaker Nick Broomfield investigates the case of the Grim Sleeper, a serial killer terrorizing South Central Los Angeles for 25 years.

title: A Secret to Die For
description: Nestled within an affluent suburb of Detroit, Jane and Bob Bashara live a picture-perfect life with a strong community of friends and grown children; they seem like a happy couple, but they are living in a complicated web of shocking, dark secrets.

title: A Secret to Die For
description: The double life of Ashlie Stapp fueled her addiction; she kept her US Marine boyfriend in the dark while manipulating ham radio operator Henry Stange into giving her painkillers, with fatal results for this love triangle.

title: A Secret to Die For
description: Discover why the perfect life of Scott Rogers, a charismatic pastor in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, was just smoke and mirrors. Untangle a web of lies, deceptions, and heinous crimes that left two people dead and tore his family and community apart.

title: A Secret to Die For
description: Looking beneath the veneer of money, connections and fast cars that surrounded Tennessee couple Joe and Tina Corona; learning how secret lovers, shady investments and threats to reveal Joe's financial sins added up to the perfect recipe for murder.

title: A Secret to Die For
description: Examining the evil acts that Jennifer Sybert, a hairdresser in Florida, tried to keep hidden from her colleague, top stylist Joleen Cummings; an entanglement with Joleen's ex blows the lid off Jennifer's criminal past, and leads to a ghastly slaying.

title: Murder at First Swipe
description: Unravel the web of lies that allowed a dating-app killer to hide in plain sight.

title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
description: Ross Kemp starts his journey under Blackfriars Bridge, the location of Britain's first mafia hit, before following the money trail across the UK.

title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
description: Probing the rise of the U.S. Mafia empire and a war that led to European expansion.

title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
description: Follow the trail of Colombian cocaine that fueled the Mafia's illicit networks.

title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
description: Look at how Spain became a criminal haven and meet the most brutal Mafia branch.

title: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
description: Get inside Italy's most sensational Mafia trial and discover its UK connection.

title: Murder Detective
description: In April 2019, the remains of a woman were found in a freezer in an apartment in London's East End; investigators brought the freezer to be x-rayed and revealed two bodies.

title: Murder Detective
description: Laurent Bonomo and Gabriel Ferez are awoken in the middle of the night and tied up after Sonnex and Farmer climbed through an open window of their flat in New Cross, south London.

title: Murder Detective
description: A murder of a bouncer in New Cross where dog DNA is used for the first time; George, a doorman described as a "gentle giant," was stabbed to death over a £5 entry fee.

title: Murder Detective
description: In 2013, Simon Hall finally admitted to the brutal murder of Joan Albert that had occurred over a decade earlier.

title: Murder Detective
description: On 11 May 2006, Nisha Patel-Nasri was upstairs getting ready for bed when she heard the front door open. She grabbed a flashlight and went to confront the intruder. She was stabbed in the thigh with a John Lewis knife from her kitchen.

title: The Footballer Fraudster
description: How a serial con artist swindled fans by posing as different sports stars.

title: Made for Murder
description: Maria Sanutti-Spencer was, allegedly, raised by a mobster; she talks the talk but when her husband dares to leave, her threats turn out to be far from empty.

title: Made for Murder
description: A frantic call to police alerts the NYPD that one of their own is under attack. Retired cop Patrick Giluley is a seasoned veteran, discovering if he is a match for a woman scorned.

title: Made for Murder
description: The story of Annegret Donnelly, who controlled her husband, Christopher, with horrific violence and abuse before eventually killing him with a rolling pin in the family home in Buckinghamshire.

title: Hunting the Catfish Crime Gang
description: Having posted his life on social media, James Blake's identity is stolen and used in scams; as he sets out to try and get his face and name back, James discovers a modern-day crime wave where ruthless organized gangs are using the latest technology.

title: Murder suspect
description: Work with the Hull Major Crime Team to unravel a case in which twin brothers bent on revenge beat a man to death; discover which twin delivered the fatal punch before the clock ticks down and the suspects are released.
